chunks: Do not undertake a journey on Friday until you have attended the prayers, except when you are going in the way of Allāh, or in an excusable matter.

key_terms.أَمْرٍ تُعْذَرُ بِهِ: An excusable matter (a valid reason for absence)
key_terms.تَشْهَدَ الصَّلَاةَ: Attend the prayer (specifically the Friday congregational prayer)
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: In the way of God (for a religious cause, such as jihad or pilgrimage)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on traveling on Friday before the congregational prayer in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) emphasizes the priority of communal worship by prohibiting travel on Friday until the congregational prayer is performed, linking physical movement with spiritual presence. This ruling, found in his letter to al-Haarith al-Hamdani, underscores the significance of Jumu'ah as a pillar of social cohesion in Shia jurisprudence, with exceptions made for jihad or valid necessities.
